cold_start_contract: First actual read constructs the OCR engine. ORT/RapidOCR and production module imports are measured separately above, never silently added into each frame.
cache_contract: Each actual forced read is followed by one unforced same-byte read. External wall time measures cache cost. Current scope-aware source reports current-call read_timing/elapsed_ms; older PR12 cached elapsed_ms belongs to the original computation. The per-observation flag states which contract was actually observed.
accounting_contract: Inclusive method totals are nested, not additive. Exclusive method totals subtract immediate-child intervals and sum to the Perception.read interval. The exclusive component table is additive: primary_ocr is detection-enabled OCR outside ShopReader; field_ocr is recognition-only numeric OCR outside ShopReader; shop_ocr is OCR within ShopReader. ShopReader.read inclusive also contains shop_ocr and any internal initialization, so it is not added again to those component buckets. Engine initialization is always shown separately. Direct RapidOCR calls retain image shape, detection mode and caller. Missing private shop/state assets remain unknown; no synthetic shop or confidence injection.
